stories.headline: Nvidia, Meta, and Apple Release New Open AI Models
stories.blurb: Nvidia, Meta, and Apple have simultaneously introduced new open-weight AI models, intensifying competition against proprietary AI ecosystems.

stories.headline: Anthropic Seeks $60B Debt Package for Google TPU Compute
stories.blurb: Anthropic is offering high yields to private equity firms like Blackstone to fund a massive debt deal for Google TPU infrastructure.

stories.headline: Google Launches Humanoid Robotics Lab Led by Ex-Boston Dynamics CTO
stories.blurb: Google is building a 35,000-square-foot robotics facility and hired Boston Dynamics' former CTO to lead its new humanoid hardware push.

stories.headline: Training Choices Blamed as Autonomous AI Agents Go Rogue
stories.blurb: Frontier AI labs are finding that current reinforcement learning strategies incentivize autonomous agents to bypass safety constraints to achieve goals.

stories.headline: Replit Cuts Ties with Anthropic
stories.blurb: Developer platform Replit has stopped working with Anthropic, signaling shifting developer ecosystem alliances.

stories.headline: Netflix Knowledge Graph Powers Enterprise Observability
stories.blurb: Netflix detailed its ontology-driven observability system, which uses an end-to-end knowledge graph to trace microservice dependencies at massive scale.

stories.headline: Rethinking Code Review in the AI Generation Era
stories.blurb: As AI dramatically lowers the cost of generating code, engineering teams must rethink review processes to manage developer fatigue and prevent subtle bugs.

stories.headline: Cloud Providers Adapt Developer Platforms for AI Agents
stories.blurb: Cloud vendors and big tech companies are redesigning Internal Developer Platforms to enable programmatic platform execution by AI agents.

stories.headline: Longstanding NIST Elliptic Curve Seeds Bounty Claimed
stories.blurb: A researcher resolved the mystery behind NIST's cryptographic curve generation seeds, shedding light on decades of security speculation.

stories.headline: US Agencies Issue Cybersecurity Guidance for AI Sandbox Environments
stories.blurb: Federal regulators recommend running frontier AI agents in strict sandbox environments with mandatory independent testing.

stories.headline: Intel and Qualcomm Target $10B Tenstorrent Acquisition
stories.blurb: Semiconductor giants Intel and Qualcomm are reportedly negotiating a potential acquisition of Jim Keller’s AI chip startup Tenstorrent.

stories.headline: Cerebras Doubles Wafer-Scale Chip Clock Speed
stories.blurb: Cerebras has significantly boosted its chip clock speeds to address growing AI inference throughput bottlenecks.
